# Block, never spin, at or above the watchdog task's priority

The watchdog is kicked by one ordinary CPU0 task; a busy loop that outranks it lets the watchdog reset the camera.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

On the E-M10 Mark II the kicker PER_WDT runs at priority 55, the level fenykl's loader task also uses. Wait with a task sleep or a queue, semaphore or flag wait in every task a payload creates.

> **What happens:** A watchdog reset; with a card payload that crashes at start, possibly on every boot.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use); [Fails to start, restarts or loops at power-on](index.md#start-failure)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The payload rules name PER_WDT and its priority and forbid busy loops in tasks that outrank it. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/sdk/README.md#payload-rules)**
